citation.clause_title: Room Rent, Boarding and Nursing Expenses
citation.exact_text: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses are limited to 1% of the Sum Insured per day, subject to a maximum of Rs. 5,000/- per day. If the Insured occupies a room with a tariff exceeding this limit, all associated medical expenses (including doctor visit fees, surgeon charges, operation theatre and nursing fees) will be deducted proportionately in accordance with the formula: Eligible Amount = (Capped Room Limit / Actual Room Tariff) * Incurred Charges.

A co-payment of 20% is applicable to each and every admissible claim incurred by any insured person who has attained the age of 61 years or more at the time of hospitalization, irrespective of hospital network status.

For emergency hospitalisation, pre-authorization request must be submitted to the Company/TPA within 24 hours of hospital admission or prior to discharge, whichever is earlier. For planned procedures, intimation must reach at least 48 hours prior to admission.

waiting_periods.description: No treatment covered except accidental trauma within first 30 days.
Knee replacement, cataract, hernia, gallstones covered only after 24 continuous months.
Hypertension, diabetes complications covered after 36 months of continuous coverage.

key_exclusions: Non-medical items and hygiene consumables (gloves, sanitizers, surgical masks, cotton rolls)
Vitamins, tonics, and food supplements unless prescribed as part of parenteral nutrition
Admission solely for diagnostic investigation without active inpatient therapy

all_citations.clause_title: Room Rent, Boarding and Nursing Expenses
all_citations.exact_text: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses are limited to 1% of the Sum Insured per day, subject to a maximum of Rs. 5,000/- per day. If the Insured occupies a room with a tariff exceeding this limit, all associated medical expenses (including doctor visit fees, surgeon charges, operation theatre and nursing fees) will be deducted proportionately in accordance with the formula: Eligible Amount = (Capped Room Limit / Actual Room Tariff) * Incurred Charges.
Intensive Care Unit (ICU) and Intensive Cardiac Care Unit (ICCU) charges are covered up to a limit of 2% of the Sum Insured per day, equivalent to Rs. 10,000/- per day.

A co-payment of 20% is applicable to each and every admissible claim incurred by any insured person who has attained the age of 61 years or more at the time of hospitalization, irrespective of hospital network status.

For emergency hospitalisation, pre-authorization request must be submitted to the Company/TPA within 24 hours of hospital admission or prior to discharge, whichever is earlier. For planned procedures, intimation must reach at least 48 hours prior to admission.

Items classified under IRDAI Non-Payable List I (disposable PPE kits, gloves, thermometer, spirometer, cotton wool, surgical tape) are not eligible for indemnity unless covered under an optional specific rider.

citation.clause_title: No Room Rent Sub-limits & Zero Proportionate Deduction
citation.exact_text: The Policy provides coverage for Room Rent, Boarding and Nursing expenses for any room category chosen by the insured (including Single Private AC Room or Deluxe Room). No proportionate deduction shall be applied on associated medical costs irrespective of room category selected.

citation.clause_title: Zero Co-payment Across All Age Bands
citation.exact_text: Claims under Optima Secure are settled with 0% mandatory co-payment across all ages, including senior citizens aged 60 and above, across our empanelled network hospitals nationwide.
Immediate emergency admission approval within 1 hour of complete document receipt at the cashless desk. Intimation window for emergency hospitalisation is 24 hours.

waiting_periods.description: Standard 30-day waiting period, waived for accidental injury.
Standard list of 16 specific illnesses covered after 24 months.

key_exclusions: Cosmetic surgery, obesity procedures, hormone replacement unless medically essential
Rest cure, rehabilitation, and respite care
Hazardous adventure sports accidents unless endorsed

citation.clause_title: Room Category Cap - Single Private Room
citation.exact_text: Eligibility is up to a Single Private Room with standard amenities. In case of admission to a Suite or Deluxe room exceeding standard single private tariff, the claim for associated medical and surgical expenses shall be adjusted in proportion to the allowed tariff.

citation.clause_title: Zone B Treatment Co-payment & Senior Copay
citation.exact_text: A 10% co-payment applies if the insured residing in Zone B is treated in a Zone A Metro hospital, or if the patient is aged 65 years or above.
Pre-authorization request should be dispatched to Care Health TPA desk at the hospital within 24 hours of emergency admission.
